lines.1: --Friday at the end of the week.
lines.2: Subaru could not come over, so I stopped at a convenience store for food on the way home from cram school.
lines.5: This was the one Konoe had been eating so happily, right?
lines.6: Now I was curious. I bought one.
lines.7: ...On the way home, I happened to glance at the bench.
lines.9: But today she looked kind of depressed.
lines.10: 「Wasn't Friday bread day? I thought you were supposed to be happy.」
lines.11: 「I do not have any money, so I cannot buy it!」
lines.12: 「Wow, you are in a bad mood.」
lines.14: 「Wait, no money? It does not even cost two hundred yen.」
lines.15: 「I went out with my friends and spent more than I budgeted...」
lines.18: 「I happen to have that bread. Want it?」
lines.22: 「Why? It is not expired or anything.」
lines.23: 「That is not what I mean. I do not accept charity.」
lines.27: Konoe was so easy to read.
lines.28: 「You are being dramatic over one piece of bread.」
lines.29: 「A Kani-sawa I know would snatch it right out of my hands without a second thought.」
lines.30: 「Kanisawa... Oh, that loud girl from Class Three.」
lines.31: 「No. If I accept something from a problem child, it feels like taking a bribe.」
lines.34: I had only meant it as a simple kindness because she had looked so happy eating it before. It felt cruel that she had to go without.
lines.35: 「Fine. Then I will eat the bread right here.」
lines.38: 「Hey! Why do you have to eat it here of all places?」
lines.41: 「This is a public place, is it not!?」
lines.43: 「And look at all that peanut butter. Delicious.」
lines.47: 「...Sorry. I took the teasing too far.」
lines.48: 「Do not pity me! That gets on my nerves.」
lines.51: 「You are literally drooling and still refuse to be honest...」
lines.52: 「This is ridiculous. Fine, I will eat it myself.」
lines.53: 「Wait. Who said I was not going to eat it!?」
lines.55: 「Now that I think about it, this is less a bribe and more compensation for all the trouble you usually cause me.」
lines.56: 「So I suppose I will accept it on those grounds.」
lines.60: 「I will eat one of the other buns too.」
lines.62: She ate with a blissful expression.
lines.63: It was kind of adorable, so I stayed quiet instead of teasing her.
lines.64: I looked around while eating a yakisoba bun.
lines.65: People came and went through the streets.
lines.66: It was not exactly a beautiful view.
lines.67: So instead, I looked up at the sky.
lines.71: Konoe drank from the thermos she had brought with her.
lines.72: 「By the way, you said you did not have enough money.」
lines.76: 「There are girls in our class who get five thousand. More than a few, even.」
lines.77: 「If I need clothes or something, my parents give me the money.」
lines.78: 「And sometimes I get extra if everyone is going to a movie or something, so I do not think it is that little.」
lines.79: 「But buying whatever you want just for yourself is hard...」
lines.81: Apparently her allowance would increase as she moved up through school.
lines.82: 「Until then, all I can do is be frugal every day.」
lines.83: 「Is that why you bring a thermos?」
lines.85: 「...My food costs and other things are included, so I actually have a decent amount of spending money.」
lines.87: 「If I lose at the arcade, dropping another two or three hundred yen into continues is pretty normal.」
lines.88: 「Then there is no helping you at all!」
lines.89: 「You would be better off sitting here doing nothing.」
lines.90: 「Seriously, what are you always doing here?」
lines.91: 「I told you. I rest here for twenty minutes.」
lines.92: 「State your objective in ten words or fewer.」
lines.93: 「The objective is to have no objective.」
lines.95: 「That is just because you are too stupid to understand.」
lines.97: 「Once I get home, I have chores to help with and studying and all kinds of things to do.」
lines.98: 「Sometimes I need twenty minutes where I can stop monitoring everything around me and just relax by myself.」
lines.100: Time where you could truly relax by yourself... I thought I understood the feeling.
lines.101: 「Can someone who is always playing around really understand that?」
lines.102: 「I cannot relate, but I can accept it.」
lines.103: 「Putting everything you just said together, if you want to relax alone, then I am in the way.」
lines.104: 「Look at that. Your brain does work sometimes.」
lines.108: 「See you. You should head home soon too.」
lines.110: I was planning to go have some fun first, but she would get mad if I said so, so I gave her a vague answer.
lines.111: I watched Konoe's back as she walked away.
lines.113: Outside school, she talked about herself a lot more than she ever did in class.
lines.114: I decided I would keep coming here now and then just to annoy her.
lines.115: Something about her made me want to poke at her.
lines.116: Later, Subaru put it this way.
lines.117: 「Kid, that is the elementary-school impulse to pick on the girl you like because you want her attention.」
lines.118: I did not realize it until he said it.
lines.119: I suppose I had developed a faint crush on her.
lines.120: So the two-step routine continued: I saw Konoe at school by day and again after cram school at night.
lines.121: Before I knew it, we had started meeting each other's eyes at odd little moments.
